datasets.source_organization: European Space Agency (ESA) / Airbus Defence & Space
datasets.intended_use: 3D geomorphic evidence, slope, elevation profiling, and Topographic Position Index (TPI) extraction

geographic_coverage.region: Noamundi - Singhbhum - Keonjhar Iron Ore Belt

datasets.licence_and_permitted_usage: Copernicus Open Access Free and Open Data Policy (Worldwide open commercial and non-commercial research use)
datasets.crs: EPSG:32645 (UTM Zone 45N) for aligned raster; EPSG:4326 for native tiles
datasets.known_limitations: Surface elevation represents digital surface model (DSM including canopy tops and open pit benches). Resampling to 20m UTM grid does not introduce new spatial detail beyond 30m sensor resolution.

datasets.dataset_name: Copernicus Sentinel-2 Level-2A BOA Surface Reflectance (Tile T44QMK)
datasets.source_organization: European Space Agency (ESA) / Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem (CDSE)
datasets.intended_use: Manganese prospectivity mapping in Balaghat-Nagpur Mining Belt

geographic_coverage.region: Balaghat - Bharweli - Ukwa Manganese Belt, Madhya Pradesh

datasets.licence_and_permitted_usage: Copernicus Sentinel Open Data Policy (Full, free, and open access)
datasets.label_provenance: Calibrated against GSI 1:2M National Mineral Inventory & 20 verified manganese mines (Bharweli, Balaghat, Ukwa, Tirodi, Dongri Buzurg, etc.)
datasets.known_limitations: Model validity is strictly confined to Sentinel-2 Tile T44QMK. Out-of-tile extrapolation is prohibited by software guardrails.

datasets.dataset_name: Copernicus Sentinel-2 Level-2A BOA Surface Reflectance (Tile T45QUE - Noamundi)
datasets.intended_use: Iron ore surface alteration mapping (B04/B02 ferric iron, B11/B12 ferrous ratios) at Noamundi

geographic_coverage.region: Noamundi - Joda - Kiriburu Iron Ore Belt, Jharkhand/Odisha

datasets.label_provenance: 5 confirmed open-pit leases (Noamundi, Joda East, Kiriburu, Gua, Bolani) vs. background sampling
datasets.known_limitations: Under leave-deposit-out spatial cross-validation, models trained on optical Sentinel-2 features collapse to 47.7% accuracy / 0.31 macro F1 due to regolith/laterite confounding. Optical features alone cannot resolve subsurface iron reserves.

datasets.dataset_name: Geological Survey of India (GSI) & IBM Curated Mineral Occurrences Inventory
datasets.source_organization: Geological Survey of India (GSI) / Indian Bureau of Mines (IBM)
datasets.intended_use: Verified deposit locations, metallogenic boundaries, geological host stratigraphy, and spatial validation blocking

geographic_coverage.region: Pan-India metallogenic terranes (Singhbhum, Sausar, Godavari, Damodar, Eastern Ghats)

datasets.licence_and_permitted_usage: Government of India Open Data / GSI Bhukosh public portal publication
datasets.label_provenance: GSI Miscellaneous Publications, IBM Directory of Mining Leases, CMPDI Coalfield Atlases, NALCO Technical Reports
datasets.known_limitations: An occurrence marker proves past or current mining activity, but does not prove unmined grade at arbitrary surrounding coordinates. Greenfield areas without recorded occurrences may still possess permissive basement framework.

datasets.dataset_name: GSI High-Resolution Aeromagnetic & 1:50,000 Geological Vector Database
datasets.source_organization: Geological Survey of India (GSI) Geodata Division
datasets.intended_use: Subsurface structural lineaments, magnetic anomalies, and fold-hinge BIF trap delineation

geographic_coverage.region: Singhbhum-Orissa Craton & Central Indian Tectonic Zone

datasets.licence_and_permitted_usage: Government of India Restricted / Classified Data Policy (Ministry of Mines). Requires institutional MOU and non-disclosure authorization.
datasets.known_limitations: Restricted by Government of India data security regulations. Cannot be legally downloaded without official credentials. The system maintains an explicit data contract stub documenting ingestion requirements.

datasets.dataset_name: CMPDI / SCCL Subsurface Borehole Core Logs & Coal Seam Correlation
datasets.source_organization: Central Mine Planning and Design Institute (CMPDI) / Singareni Collieries Company Limited (SCCL)
datasets.intended_use: Subsurface seam thickness, depth, calorific value, and coal rank training

geographic_coverage.region: Gondwana Coal Basins (Godavari, Damodar, Mahanadi, Son, Wardha)

datasets.licence_and_permitted_usage: Proprietary exploration data owned by Coal India Limited / SCCL
datasets.known_limitations: Optical satellites only measure surface reflectance and cannot sense underground coal seams under 10m to 500m of sandstone/shale overburden. Without borehole logs, subsurface coal training is mathematically impossible without fabrication.

datasets.dataset_name: NALCO & State DGM Bauxite Plateau Drill Core XRF Assays
datasets.source_organization: National Aluminium Company (NALCO) / Odisha Directorate of Geology
datasets.intended_use: Chemical ore grade differentiation (Al2O3 >= 40% vs. low-grade ferruginous laterite)

geographic_coverage.region: East Coast Bauxite Province (Koraput, Rayagada, Kalahandi plateaus >900m ASL)

datasets.label_provenance: XRF laboratory assay of borehole core samples
datasets.known_limitations: Surface SWIR Al-OH spectral absorption (B11/B12) indicates aluminous clay minerals, but cannot measure chemical Al2O3 vs. reactive silica ratios. Commercial bauxite cannot be separated from sub-grade laterite without assay data.
